verdicts.note: His cost-cutting is clear: he questions county-funded services such as SPiN Cafe, would remodel the jail rather than replace it, and would have volunteers review plans [S8]. But the same issues page asks for funding to fill the deputy shortage, expand law-enforcement presence and invest in investigative training, and for flexible work and professional development to keep county staff [S4]. A candidate who seeks new spending in a major area is not 'fully pole_a'. The direction holds at magnitude 1.

Trimming "non-essential" building codes and cutting permitting delays [S4] is pole_a. The second half of the basis does not support pole_a. Opposing the state requirement to plan for population growth [S8], and worrying that the state low-income housing plan will add residents [S4], are arguments for restricting growth, not for letting the market build. One clear supply-side statement, partly offset by skepticism about growth, supports -1, not -2.
